extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, stakeholders, and applicants for endangered-species permits; interested commenters; tribal/state/local/federal agencies
extracted.subtask_description: Federal Register notices inviting public comment on Endangered Species Act (ESA) and Marine Mammal Protection Act (MMPA) permit applications, announcing committee meetings, and describing permit issuance (including emergency exemptions, amendments, and modifications). These notices specify deadlines, how to access application materials, legal/regulatory citations, and the criteria/process the agencies will use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation to comment before issuing permits
rubrics_metrics.description: The ESA requires that we invite public comment before issuing permits for any activity otherwise prohibited by the ESA with respect to any endangered species.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices explicitly invite the public and local, State, Tribal, and Federal agencies to comment on permit applications; agencies state they will take into consideration any information received during the public comment period prior to issuing requested permits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comment deadlines / timeliness
rubrics_metrics.description: Notices specify firm deadlines by which the agency 'must receive comments' (e.g., 'We must receive comments by April 1, 2026', 'by May 1, 2026', 'by May 26, 2026').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit comments by the published date to ensure consideration; some notices include language 'To ensure your comment is...' or similar directions on timeliness. Emergency actions may waive typical notice periods (see emergency exemption).

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of application materials / where to obtain documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Materials pertaining to permit applications are available online at https://www.regulations.gov, via the Federal Register public inspection PDF, by written request (email) to agency contacts, or via FOIA requests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices provide links, public inspection PDF URLs, emails (e.g., NMFS.Pr1Comments@noaa.gov), and phone contacts for obtaining permit applications, permits, and related documents; specify how interested parties can review supporting materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statutory/regulatory citations governing permits
rubrics_metrics.description: Notices cite the statutory/regulatory framework for permit types (e.g., section 10(a)(1)(A) of the ESA; the Marine Mammal Protection Act where applicable) and specific CFR sections for recovery permits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For recovery permits, implementing regulations are identified at 50 CFR 17.22 (endangered wildlife), 50 CFR 17.32 (threatened wildlife), 50 CFR 17.62 (endangered plants), and 50 CFR 17.72 (threatened plants); other notices reference ESA and CITES authorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permit-issuance evaluation: consideration of application materials and public comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Before issuing permits, the agency considers the information submitted with each permit application and the public comments received.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices state that permits were issued 'after considering the information submitted with each permit application and the public comments received' and that issuance decisions may be conditioned accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permits issued subject to conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: When the agency issues permits under the ESA (or MMPA), the permits are issued subject to certain conditions set forth in each permit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices announce that requested permits were issued 'subject to certain conditions' — conditions typically specify allowed activities, limitations on take, monitoring, reporting, or mitigation requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emergency exemption / waiver of 30-day public notice
rubrics_metrics.description: The Service may waive the 30-day public notice period and issue an emergency endangered-species permit (e.g., import of five tigers) under the ESA and CITES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emergency notices explain the waiver of the 30-day notice and provide instructions for accessing materials (often via FOIA) and contact information; these actions are explicitly labeled 'Emergency Exemption.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Notices for permits, amendments, and modifications (MMPA and ESA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies publish notices when permits, permit amendments, and permit modifications have been issued under the MMPA and the ESA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices list issued permits and related file numbers, indicate availability of permits for review upon request (email), and provide contact persons (names and phone numbers) for further information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation to comment on foreign-endangered-species permit applications
rubrics_metrics.description: The Service invites public comment on applications to conduct activities with foreign species listed as endangered under the ESA; the ESA requires public comment before issuing permits for such activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices for foreign species include deadlines for comment, addresses for submission, and remind that, with some exceptions, the ESA prohibits activities with listed species unless federal authorization is issued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recovery-permit purpose and common activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Recovery (section 10(a)(1)(A)) permits are for scientific research to promote conservation or other activities intended to enhance propagation or survival of endangered and threatened species; these often include capture and collection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices explain the conservation-oriented purposes of recovery permits and that the activities would otherwise constitute prohibited take absent a permit; they reference the applicable CFR implementing sections and invite comment on the applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Endangered Species Committee exemption procedure (section 7(h))
rubrics_metrics.description: The Endangered Species Committee (created by the ESA Amendments of 1978) can grant exemptions under section 7(h) from ESA requirements for reasons such as national security when the Secretary so finds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices announce Committee meetings called by the Secretary (Chairman), specify meeting date/time/location, state the meeting is open to the public (including livestreaming), and report decisions (e.g., unanimous vote to exempt specified activities).

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact and submission instructions required in notices
rubrics_metrics.description: Federal Register notices provide specific points of contact (names, phone numbers, emails) and addresses for submitting comments or requesting documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commenters should use the provided contact details and submission channels (regulations.gov, agency email, FOIA) as described in each notice to ensure their information is considered; notices often name the staff member and file numbers.
